sources.title: Bob Log III — issuing-label documented solo stage configuration
sources.support_notes: Issuing label positively describes one-man band with kick drum, homemade foot-cymbal, slide guitar, telephone voice and additional drum-machine accompaniment, and quotes his Tucson self-introduction. The label-hosted Dreaded Press review supplies secondary archtop detail; Bob Log III’s signed first-person Sony Music guitar story independently establishes his archtop acoustic/electric slide-guitar practice. All five families retained; no convenient omission of electronic drum accompaniment or foot cymbal.

sources.title: Issuing label album presentation

sources.title: Bob Log III — My Guitars, signed first-person artist story hosted by Sony Music
sources.support_notes: Artist identifies his Silvertone archtop acoustic/electric guitars and explains that his high-action blue/yellow archtop works for slide and was used to write most songs. This confirms the archtop-slide practice; it does not establish the authored spruce, pickup model, strings or exact selected stage guitar. Other guitars in this personal collection are not claimed simultaneous performance roles.
